agent_data_note: Use the real LOSVER datasets at `dataset_candidate/losver/`. The mount is read-only; copy code/data into `project/` before writing outputs.
benchmark_rules: Use the complete real provided Devign / Big-Vul / PrimeVul files under `dataset_candidate/losver/datasets/`; do not invent substitute CSVs or toy functions when the corpus is readable.
Read `dataset_candidate/dataset_paths.json` before experiments and use `$LOSVER_HOME`, `$DEVIGN_HOME`, `$BIGVUL_HOME`, `$PRIMEVUL_HOME`, `$LOSVER_REPOS` in scripts.
The shared package is read-only. Copy `source_code/` and selected jsonl files into `project/` before editing scripts or writing checkpoints.
The Python environment is installed automatically (`python` or `/opt/ase-2025-020-venv/bin/python`) with CPU torch + transformers. Reinstall a CUDA wheel only if a GPU is actually available.
Evaluate binary detection accuracy on Devign, weighted F1 on Big-Vul CWE classification, and pair-wise accuracy on PrimeVul paired functions.

Line-level ground truth is available for all three datasets, so `top_n_accuracy` and `line_level_f1` must be reported on Devign: use `devign/*_with_lines.jsonl` (field `lines_ground_truth`, drop records whose value is `[-1]`). Big-Vul line labels come from `func_before` vs `func_after`; PrimeVul from the paired records.

Regenerate Devign line labels offline with `build_devign_line_gt.py` against the bare clones under `$LOSVER_REPOS` if you change the preprocessing; do not fetch from the network and do not fabricate line labels.
Figshare checkpoints are not pre-mounted. Do not treat them as required for a scoped valid experiment.
Scope down from the paper protocol (full UniXcoder 40+8/16 epoch training on V100) when needed — report the reduced subset, token limit, and hardware.
Do not claim full paper reproduction unless the protocol and resources match.
non_goals: Requiring GPU / CUDA for a valid scoped experiment
Re-cloning FFmpeg and QEMU inside the container (bare clones are already mounted read-only at `$LOSVER_REPOS`)
Downloading Figshare pretrained checkpoints (~author models) as a required dependency
Fabricating Devign / Big-Vul / PrimeVul labels without documenting synthetic construction
